ingredients.name: Palm oil
ingredients.summary: A common vegetable oil high in saturated fats.
ingredients.details: Palm oil is widely used as a cooking oil and in processed foods. While it contributes to texture and shelf life, it is high in saturated fat, which can impact heart health if consumed in excess.

ingredients.name: Canola oil
ingredients.summary: Oil rich in monounsaturated fats and omega-3s.
ingredients.details: Canola oil is generally considered healthier than palm oil due to higher monounsaturated fat content, though processing may vary. Use in moderation as part of a balanced diet.

ingredients.name: Soy lecithin
ingredients.details: Emulsifier widely used to stabilize mixtures. Some soy lecithin may contain trace soy proteins; individuals with soy allergy should be cautious.

ingredients.name: Wheat flour
ingredients.details: Wheat flour contains gluten; not suitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity. Adds structure and bulk to baked products.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.details: Excessive sugar intake is linked to obesity, metabolic syndrome, and dental issues. Used for sweetness and browning.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.details: High sodium content can raise blood pressure in sensitive individuals. Used for flavor and preservation.

ingredients.name: Corn starch
ingredients.summary: Starch used as thickener or filler.
ingredients.details: Corn starch is a carbohydrate thickener with minimal intrinsic health risk for most people when consumed in typical amounts.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.details: Spices are generally safe but can contain added flavors or allergens depending on processing. They enhance flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.details: Garlic is a common, generally safe ingredient; can cause digestive upset in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Whole milk powder
ingredients.summary: Dried milk product containing lactose and dairy proteins.
ingredients.details: Dairy ingredient provides flavor and texture; contains lactose which may affect lactose-intolerant individuals.

ingredients.name: Skim milk powder
ingredients.details: Dairy ingredient with reduced fat; contains lactose and dairy proteins. Not suitable for dairy-free diets.

ingredients.name: Caramel color
ingredients.summary: Colorant used to impart brown color.
ingredients.details: Food coloring derived from caramelization of sugar; generally considered safe in typical amounts but may contain trace contaminants depending on process.

ingredients.name: Monosodium glutamate
ingredients.details: MSG enhances umami taste; some individuals report sensitivity (headache, flushing) but majority tolerate well. Not universally problematic.

ingredients.name: Defatted soybean
ingredients.summary: Soybean meal/defatted soybean powder used as protein source.
ingredients.details: Source of plant protein; may carry soy allergen risk for sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Yeast extract
ingredients.details: Contains natural glutamates and other amino compounds; generally safe but may contribute to MSG-like taste components.

ingredients.name: Natural and artificial flavors
ingredients.details: Complex mixtures that may include allergens or be proprietary; some individuals may have sensitivities.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.details: Contains sugars; not suitable for infants under 1 year. Generally safe for adults in moderation.

ingredients.name: Dextrin
ingredients.details: Used as thickener or filler; typically considered safe.

ingredients.name: Pasteurized milk
ingredients.details: Contains lactose and dairy proteins; dairy allergy or lactose intolerance applies.

ingredients.name: Cheese cultures
ingredients.summary: Microbial cultures used to ferment cheese.
ingredients.details: Contributes to cheese flavor; generally safe for lactose-tolerant individuals.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.details: Broad category; many enzymes are safe, but specifics matter for those with allergies to enzyme preparations.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.details: Already noted earlier; contributes to overall sodium intake.

ingredients.name: Onion flakes
ingredients.details: Common flavoring; generally safe; may cause gas in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Dextrin
ingredients.details: Repeated entry; safe in typical amounts; used as filler/thickener.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.summary: Fermented sauce containing soy and wheat.
ingredients.details: Contains gluten from wheat and soy protein; high in sodium; flavor enhancer and salt source.

ingredients.name: Onion extract
ingredients.details: Used for flavor; generally safe; watch for onion allergy or intolerance.

ingredients.name: Tomato powder
ingredients.details: Flavoring/coloring agent with natural sugars; generally safe.

ingredients.name: Dried onion
ingredients.details: Flavoring; similar considerations to onion flakes.

ingredients.name: Glucose

ingredients.name: Sucrose fatty acid esters
ingredients.summary: Emulsifier derived from sugar and fatty acids.
ingredients.details: Food additive used to improve texture; generally regarded as safe.

ingredients.name: Dextrose anhydrous glucose

ingredients.name: Banana

ingredients.name: Processed honey

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.details: Flavor and color; generally safe.

ingredients.name: Fermented milk
ingredients.details: Contains dairy; probiotics flavor considerations; lactose content depends on product.

ingredients.name: Citric acid
ingredients.details: Common food additive; safe in typical amounts but can be harsh for sensitive individuals in high concentrations.

ingredients.name: Enzymes

ingredients.name: Tomato extract

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.summary: Common solvent and humectant in cosmetics.
ingredients.details: Water (aqua) is the principal solvent in many skincare formulations. It is considered safe when used in topical products, with no known systemic risks at typical concentrations.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.summary: Humectant that attracts moisture to the skin.
ingredients.details: Glycerin is widely used to improve hydration. It is generally non-irritating and safe for topical use, though very high concentrations can feel sticky; typical cosmetic concentrations are well tolerated.

ingredients.name: Olive Fruit Oil
ingredients.summary: Plant-derived emollient rich in fatty acids.
ingredients.details: Olea europaea (olive) fruit oil provides lubrication and can help soften skin. Generally safe for topical use with rare sensitivities.

ingredients.name: Butylene Glycol
ingredients.summary: Humectant and solvent that helps with texture and penetration.
ingredients.details: Butylene glycol is a common cosmetic ingredient used to improve viscosity and moisture retention. Allergic reactions are uncommon; overall safety is good at typical cosmetic levels.

ingredients.name: Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil
ingredients.summary: Emollient oil rich in fatty acids.
ingredients.details: Macadamia oil provides slip and conditioning to the skin. It is generally well tolerated, though nut-derived oils can occasionally trigger allergies in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Cyclopentasiloxane
ingredients.summary: Volatile silicone used as a slip-enhancing carrier.
ingredients.details: Cyclopentasiloxane is a cyclic silicone that provides lubrication and allows product feel. It is considered low risk for topical use, though some consumers seek silicone-free formulations; not linked to systemic absorption in typical cosmetic use.

ingredients.name: Cetearyl Alcohol
ingredients.summary: Fatty alcohol used as an emollient and thickener.
ingredients.details: Cetearyl alcohol is a common conditioning ingredient that helps stabilize emulsions. It is generally non-irritating and widely considered safe for skin.

ingredients.name: Beeswax
ingredients.details: Beeswax acts as a thickener and emollient in creams and balms. It is typically safe with rare allergic reactions to bee products.

ingredients.name: Cetyl Ethylhexanoate
ingredients.summary: Emollient ester providing slip and conditioning.
ingredients.details: Cetyl ethylhexanoate is used to improve texture and skin feel. Generally safe for topical use with minimal irritation potential.

ingredients.name: Cyclohexasiloxane
ingredients.details: Cyclohexasiloxane is a volatile silicone similar to cyclopentasiloxane, used to enhance texture and spreadability. Considered low risk in standard cosmetic usage.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 60
ingredients.summary: Emulsifier/surfactant aiding mixing of oil and water.
ingredients.details: Polysorbate 60 helps oils blend into aqueous formulations and can aid delivery of actives. Generally regarded as safe in cosmetic use.

ingredients.name: Stearic Acid
ingredients.summary: Fatty acid and surfactant with emollient properties.
ingredients.details: Stearic acid is a common cleansing/emollient fatty acid. It is typically safe, though high concentrations can be mildly irritating for some individuals.

ingredients.name: Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate
ingredients.summary: Emollient and thickener derived from sugars.
ingredients.details: An FDA Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) type emulsifier/emollient for cosmetics; low irritation potential.

ingredients.name: Isopropyl Myristate
ingredients.summary: Emollient that softens and aids absorption.
ingredients.details: Commonly used to improve glide and reduce tackiness. Generally safe with rare fragrance-related sensitivities; some people may dislike the occlusive feel.

ingredients.name: PEG-100 Stearate
ingredients.details: PEG esters are used to stabilize formulations and improve texture. Generally safe; may cause irritation for very sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Glyceryl Stearate
ingredients.details: Glyceryl stearate provides slip and helps moisturize. Widely used and typically well tolerated.

ingredients.name: Witch Hazel Extract
ingredients.summary: Astringent plant extract with potential anti-inflammatory effects.
ingredients.details: Hamamelis virginiana (witch hazel) extract can help with toning and soothing, though it can be drying for some skin types due to tannins.

ingredients.name: Dimethiconol
ingredients.summary: Silicone fluid providing slip and barrier formation.
ingredients.details: Dimethiconol is a lighter silicone used to improve texture and act as a barrier. Generally regarded as safe for skin exposure.

ingredients.name: Sodium Polyacrylate
ingredients.details: Common thickener in cosmetics; generally safe with low irritation potential.

ingredients.name: 1,2-Hexanediol
ingredients.summary: Humectant and solvent with antimicrobial properties at some concentrations.
ingredients.details: 1,2-Hexanediol is used to retain moisture and assist preservation. Generally safe in cosmetic use; may cause irritation in sensitive individuals at higher concentrations.

ingredients.name: Caprylyl Glycol
ingredients.summary: Humectant and emollient with antimicrobial benefits.
ingredients.details: Caprylyl glycol helps moisturize and can act as a preservative booster. Generally safe for topical use.

ingredients.name: Shea Butter
ingredients.summary: Emollient fat from Shea tree rich in fatty acids.
ingredients.details: Shea butter provides deep moisturization and skin barrier support. Rarely causes irritation; suitable for many skin types.

ingredients.name: Anise Fruit Extract
ingredients.summary: Botanical extract with fragrance and potential antioxidant properties.
ingredients.details: Anise extract is used for scent and potential soothing effects. Some individuals may be sensitive to essential oil-type components.

ingredients.name: Disodium EDTA
ingredients.details: EDTA binds metal ions to improve product stability. Generally considered safe in cosmetics when used as directed; systemic exposure is unlikely.

ingredients.name: Betaine
ingredients.details: Betaine helps retain moisture and can soften skin. Considered safe with good skin compatibility.

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.details: Allantoin is well-known for its soothing, healing and anti-irritant properties. Generally safe for most users.

ingredients.name: Trehalose
ingredients.details: Trehalose helps retain moisture and can provide protective effects for skin cells. Considered safe in cosmetics.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 20
ingredients.details: Polysorbate 20 helps dissolve fragrance/fragrance-like components and improves texture. Generally safe for topical use.

ingredients.name: Polyglutamic Acid
ingredients.details: Polyglutamic acid binds water and can improve skin hydration. Emerging ingredient with favorable safety profile.

ingredients.name: Licorice Root Extract
ingredients.summary: Botanical extract with potential brightening effects.
ingredients.details: Licorice root extract contains glabridin and other compounds that may have soothing and skin-brightening properties; generally safe but could irritate very sensitive individuals in high concentrations.

ingredients.name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
ingredients.summary: Green tea extract with antioxidant properties.
ingredients.details: Rich in polyphenols, camellia sinensis extract offers antioxidant activity and potential anti-inflammatory effects. Generally safe for topical use.

ingredients.name: Rosemary Leaf Extract
ingredients.details: Rosemary extract provides antioxidant activity; some individuals may be sensitive to essential oil components and fragrance-like effects.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica Extract
ingredients.summary: Herbal extract with soothing and healing properties.
ingredients.details: Centella asiatica is commonly used for calming and repairing the skin; generally well tolerated.

ingredients.name: Matricaria Flower Extract
ingredients.details: Chamomile extract can help calm irritated skin; typically safe though rare sensitivities exist.

ingredients.name: Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract
ingredients.summary: Baikal skullcap root extract with anti-inflammatory properties.
ingredients.details: Baical skullcap extract is used for anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects; generally safe for topical use.

ingredients.name: Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract
ingredients.details: Polygonum cuspidatum (Japanese knotweed) root extract provides antioxidants; safe for most users though fragrance components may affect sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Xylitol
ingredients.details: Xylitol acts as a humectant and anti-irritant in some formulations. Generally safe in cosmetics.

ingredients.name: Ceramide NP
ingredients.details: Ceramide NP helps restore and maintain the skin barrier. Safe and well tolerated in topical products.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.summary: Alpha-hydroxy acid used for pH adjustment and mild exfoliation.
ingredients.details: Citric acid is used to adjust formulation pH and can provide gentle exfoliation. It may cause irritation in sensitive or compromised skin at higher concentrations.
